Meet the founder

Thoughtful design. Smarter property decisions.

I'm the founder of Sketch Arch Design, with a four-year Bachelor of Architecture degree and practical experience working in an architectural office.

My approach combines architectural thinking, creative problem-solving and a practical understanding of how spaces can be improved to better suit people's needs.

I help prospective buyers explore a property's renovation potential before making a decision, and support homeowners as they plan renovations, rethink layouts and explore design possibilities.

Whether you're considering buying a property, updating your home or exploring an extension, my goal is to help you understand your options and take the next step with greater clarity and confidence.

Sketch Arch Design — helping you see the potential in every space.
Our approach

Good design is more than how a space looks.

It’s about understanding your goals, making thoughtful choices and seeing the potential in a space. We aim to make the design process clearer, more practical and more personal.

  • Clear concepts and considered details
  • Practical advice tailored to your project
  • Visuals to help communicate design ideas
  • A collaborative, straightforward process
